zh-CN.Many people assume accurate plywood cuts: 先把项目尺寸、零件数量、材料类型和可见面要求写清楚。CutList 只有拿到真实约束，才能生成可以落地的板材排版。
zh-CN.Lay the full sheet on rigid foam insulat: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.Clamp a straightedge, a level, a factory: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.Break the sheet into manageable pieces w: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。

zh-CN.With a fine plywood blade, a scoring pas: With a fine plywood blade, a scoring pass or tape on the show face, and good support, a circular or track saw produces edges as clean as a table saw for most work. The cut quality comes from the blade and support, not the saw type. For sheet goods specifically, this setup can rival a table saw.

zh-CN.Knowing the breakdown order in advance k: Knowing the breakdown order in advance keeps you from trapping a part you need or making the heavy cuts last. A cut list with a sheet layout shows which cuts come first. The CutList app gives you the layout and the sheet count, so you can sequence a table-saw-free breakdown that turns full sheets into finished parts safely.
zh-CN.Support the sheet flat on foam or sawhor: 确认所有零件名称和数量。
zh-CN.Guide the saw with a clamped straightedg: 设置真实板材尺寸与锯缝。
zh-CN.Make long rip cuts first to reduce sheet: 检查纹理方向和可见面。
